findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution present in the kitchen during the inspection. PIC was informed and a sanitizer bucket was prepared. Ensure sanitizer is available at all times of food preparation or service.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Inspector observed the ice machine to be soiled with a black residue inside the machine. The interior of the ice machine is considered a food contact surface, and should therefore be clean to sight and touch at all times. A follow-up is scheduled for 4/6/2026 to ensure the ice machine has been cleaned and sanitized. Inspector recommends hiring a third party such as AirMasters to deep clean and sanitize the machine.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed ham and shredded mozzarella cheese to be stored in the white upright cooler without a proper date mark. The PIC was informed and dates were added to the necessary items.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the scoop of the ice machine to be stored on a surface that is not clean to sight and touch. The PIC was informed and will place scoop on a dish that can be properly ware washed and sanitized in the future. Ensure this scoop is properly stored in the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(C) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored:(C) On a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food-contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency specified under §§ 4-602.11 and 4-702.11.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Inspector observed the following storage order violations in the facility:

1. Limes stored below and on top of raw ground beef
2. Raw beef stored above cooked chili (walk-in cooler)
3. Raw bacon stored above cooked chili (walk-in cooler)
4. Raw shell eggs stored above cut tomatoes (standing 2-door cooler)

Ensure staff are storing raw ingredients below ready-to-eat (RTE) foods to prevent cross-contamination. A follow-up will be conducted on 8/11/2025 to ensure proper storage order is being followed in the facility.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the ice machine to be heavily soiled with a black residue inside the machine. The interior of the ice machine is considered a food contact surface, and should therefore be clean to sight and touch at all times. A follow-up is scheduled for 8/14/2025 to ensure the ice machine has been cleaned and sanitized. Inspector recommends hiring a third party such as AirMasters to deep clean and sanitize the machine.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspector observed cases of soda and fry oil to be stored directly on the ground in the dry storage area of the facility. Ensure food is stored a minimum of 6 inches off the floor to prevent cross-contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the standing freezers to be soiled with food debris. Ensure the bottom interior of the freezers are cleaned frequently to prevent cross-contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Observed mop head sitting in mop sink basin. PIC was informed that mop needs to be stored such that it can drip dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed raw pork stored above tomato sauce, and raw eggs stored over sauces in the upright kitchen cooler. PIC was informed of proper storage order in the coolers and the food items were rearranged. Ensure staff are storing raw foods under ready-to-eat foods to prevent cross-contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed handles on stand up freezers to be soiled with food residues. Clean and sanitize stand up freezer handles. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed interior cavity of microwave in kitchen to be soiled with food splash and debris. Clean and sanitize interior cavity of kitchen microwave. 

4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Observed boxes of single use cups and lids stored directly on floor in dry storage. Store single service articles at least 6 inches off ground. 

4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.
